aboutHeading: Engineering taught me how products work. Design taught me who they work for.
aboutIntro: I’m Tanvir, a UI/UX designer with a background in software engineering. Over the past seven years, I’ve helped teams turn complex requirements into digital products that feel clear to use and realistic to build.
aboutParagraphs: That technical foundation still shapes how I work. I think in systems, involve developers early, and ask what must happen behind the interface—not only what the finished screen should look like.
I care about the details people notice and the constraints teams live with. The best outcome is not the most decorated interface; it is one people understand and a team can confidently ship.
aboutAiHeading: I use AI as leverage, not authority.
aboutAiIntro: AI helps me streamline the design flow by speeding up repetitive and exploratory work. I stay responsible for the product judgment, accessibility, and final decisions.

aboutAiSteps.name: Explore with more range
aboutAiSteps.description: Challenge assumptions, generate alternative flows, and surface questions before I commit to a direction.

aboutAiSteps.name: Synthesize with more clarity
aboutAiSteps.description: Organise research and requirements, compare patterns, and turn scattered inputs into a useful point of view.

aboutAiSteps.name: Ship with better context
aboutAiSteps.description: Refine interface copy, check edge cases, and prepare design rationale and handoff notes that teams can act on.

services.name: Product design
services.description: Turning complex requirements into clear flows, useful interactions, and interfaces that help people complete real tasks.

services.name: Design systems
services.description: Creating reusable patterns, components, and guidance that help product and engineering teams move consistently.

services.name: Product critique
services.description: Finding friction, challenging assumptions, and giving teams a practical path from a rough product to a stronger experience.
